{{legend|#E27F90|50–60%}} {{legend|#CC2F4A|60–70%}} {{col-end}} }} {{Elections in Connecticut}} The '''2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut''' were held on November 8, 2022, to elect the five [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. representatives]] from the [[U.S. state|state]] of [[Connecticut]], one from each of the state's five [[Connecticut's congressional districts|congressional districts]]. The elections coincided with the [[2022 United States Senate election in Connecticut|2022 U.S. Senate race in Connecticut]] and the [[2022 Connecticut gubernatorial election]], as well as [[United States House of Representatives elections, 2022|other elections]] to the House of Representatives, other [[2022 United States Senate elections|elections]] to the [[United States Senate]], and various [[2022 United States elections#State elections|state]] and [[2022 United States elections#Local elections|local elections]]. This election was the closest the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] has gotten to gaining a seat since [[2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut|2006]], with representative [[Jahana Hayes]] winning re-election by a 0.79% margin. {{toclimit|2}} ==Overview== Results of the 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in
